traits.bark_colour.note: The bark colour chosen by eye for appearance (see its note), as a screen colour: it stood as appearance.bark [0.4, 0.18, 0.12], which is linear light, so the trunk drew pale grey to white beside photographs of the species (2026-10-23). It stands here in sRGB, as bark colours are picked, and the bark rule (tracheophyta) turns it into linear light.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Crane 1991) calls it "a prostrate, evergreen shrub" with trailing stems but gives no height.

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's kinnikinnick review (Crane 1991, read 2026-10-16): "Kinnikinnick is a prostrate, evergreen shrub".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's kinnikinnick review (Crane 1991, read 2026-10-16): "The leathery, dark green leaves are about 0.5 to 1 inch (1.27-2.54 cm) long".

traits.inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: racemes terminal, nodding, 4-7(-10)-flowered; FEIS (Crane 1991): flowers in terminal racemes.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: 4-7(-10) flowers to a raceme.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: corolla urceolate, white to pale pink.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: flowers 5-6 mm.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: a drupe; FEIS (Crane 1991): "bright red berrylike drupes".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FEIS's kinnikinnick review (Crane 1991, read 2026-10-16): drupes "0.25 to 0.4 inch (6-10 mm) broad"; Dendrology (pp. 78-79) gives 6-8 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: fruit red, shiny.

traits.flowering_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: flowers April to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 78-79, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi: fruit July to September (they persist through winter, FEIS, Crane 1991).

generator.params.note: Salal's values, changed by hand for kinnikinnick: a prostrate mat of trailing, rooting stems (FEIS, Crane 1991: "produces extensive trailing stems") with wide-angled, drooping branches, small leathery leaves and short nodding racemes. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 15 cm at 12 years in the open, a mat within the species-facts estimate's 5-20 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after Dendrology (pp. 78-79, "Prostrate mats of small obovate leathery leaves with pink-mouthed urns"): dark green leaves, white urns with pink mouths, shiny red drupes; reddish flaking bark (FEIS: bark "exfoliates in largish flakes").

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2647407), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2647407), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2647407), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2647407), as no source read gives it.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2647407), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Wikipedia, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi (read 2026-10-18): the leaf tips are rounded (FNA on efloras (flora_id=1, taxon 220001038) describes the blade but gives no apex).
